o1: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in epidermal cell fate specification; gonad morphogenesis; hemidesmosome assembly; ventral hypodermal cell fate specification; vulval development; and ventral enclosure. Is located in nucleus. Is expressed in AB lineage cell; E lineage cell; P9/10L; hypodermal cell; tail; ventral P cells; VulF cells; and migrating sex myoblasts (SM) and their descendants. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma and congenital myopathy 19. Orthologous to human PAX7 (paired box 7).
